remedies.description: Insert a mandatory location-data completeness and format validation step in ORG-A's notice creation process before handoff H-1 to ORG-B.
remedies.feasibility_rationale: Can be implemented as a simple rule check within the existing notice generation workflow; well under the 225‑minute budget and no stated constraints block it.
remedies.residual_gap: EVENT_ORDER rejects (1 of 3 observed) and possible carrier flakiness (U-FLAKINESS) may still generate rejects; location‑related rejects would be eliminated.
